exceptions.subject: next-auth
exceptions.reason: Auth.js v5 is the only line that supports the Next.js App Router server-side session model this application depends on. The v4 line does not, and no stable v5 release exists yet.
exceptions.reviewAction: Move to the first stable next-auth v5 release, or re-approve with a fresh expiry after confirming the beta line is still maintained and free of known advisories.
